title: Bible in a Year
note: Each day has five readings, one from each section of this Bible: the Old Testament (except Psalms and Proverbs), the Psalms, Proverbs, the New Testament, and the extra books (the Apocrypha and the Pseudepigrapha, in this Bible’s book order). Each section is divided evenly over 365 days by verse count and finishes on December 31. A long chapter is split by verse when that keeps the days even. Every book and verse is read once. On February 29 in a leap year, read the February 28 portion again, or use the day to catch up.
